title: Soul!: The Complete Series
description:
S1 E14 — Belafonte/Nelson/Poitier
Sidney Poitier and Harry Belafonte discuss their new film, Buck and the Preacher, as well as other topics, interrupted by interludes of song by Novella Nelson.

title: Soul!: The Complete Series
description:
S1 E15 — Ruby Dee/Ossie Davis
Ruby Dee and Ossie Davis, aided by the music of composer-saxophonist Lucky Thompson, give dramatic readings of the poetry of a writer named Robert Cornell Kaufman.

description:

When Tia and Tamera's SAT scores come in, A-student Tia is stunned to discover that Tamera has pulled a higher score than she has.

title: Sister, Sister
description:

After Tamera wins the lead in the school play, she transforms from a calm high school student into the ultimate "drama diva," who's driving everyone -- particularly Tia -- crazy.

title: Sister, Sister
description:

When Tia confides in Tamera that she dreamed of kissing "Stinky Steve," their boss at Rocket Burger, Steve mistakenly believes she's got "the hots" for him.

title: Sister, Sister
description:

A school project in which Tia and Tamera "marry" Michael and Roger proves to be an eye-opening experience for the twins.

title: Sister, Sister

title: Moesha

Moesha is living with Andell after having moved out of Frank & Dee’s home.

title: Moesha
description:

Moesha meets Brandy at a concert and we discover that Moesha is having a romance with Aaron, a college student.

title: Moesha
description:

With a little help from Myles and a visit from Grandma Mitchell, Moesha moves back home and returns to Crenshaw High.

title: Moesha
description:

Dee finds a joint in the couch while cleaning the house.  Frank and Dee assume and accuse Mo, but Moesha is shocked when she catches Myles smoking.

title: Moesha
description:
S4 E4 — Psyche Your Mind
Based on the family turmoil, the family begins counseling, but Moesha doesn’t want to air the family’s 'dirty laundry'.

S2 E16 — Rich Kid
Mary takes a stand against the deadly drug, crack when she discovers that a wealthy and generous new friend of Calvin and Brenda is selling the drug.

S2 E17 — A Matter Of Choice
Lester wins a major contracting bid, which enables the Jenkins' to begin looking for their dream home when Lester discovers that the backers of the construction job are involved in South African investments.

S2 E18 — Happy Twentieth
Plans made by Mary (Marla Gibbs) and Lester (Hal Williams) to celebrate their 20th wedding anniversary result in disharmony when quarreling in-laws come to town.

S2 E19 — Toyland
Guest star Pee Wee Herman plays himself in this special episode in which he, Mary (Marla Gibbs), Lester (Hal Williams) and Sandra (Jackée) are held captive in a toy store and must resort to more than pop guns and bows and arrows to set themselves free.
